hero.about: I'm a computer science student based in Brno, with a growing focus on web development and design.

frontendEngineering.title: Frontend Engineering
frontendEngineering.description: I have experience creating simple websites and with UX/UI design. I am currently working on a personal website to showcase my projects.

graphicDesign.title: Graphic Design
graphicDesign.description: As a member of a youth organization, I was responsible for creating social media posts and preparing graphic materials for events. I also designed a logo for them.

aspiringDeveloper.title: Aspiring Developer
aspiringDeveloper.description: I enjoy exploring various areas of computer science, from Python scripting and automation to artificial intelligence. I like learning by experimenting and working on different projects to understand how things actually work.

teamwork.title: Teamwork
teamwork.description: I frequently collaborate with classmates on various team projects at school. I have experience collaborating on GitHub and have also tried Jira.
